description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN phrasings for an explicit request to refine an EXISTING persona's Unique Questions from a correction sample (≥ 3 misses the lens should have caught). Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours (new-persona authoring, the governance rule, the skill-side improvement pipeline, skill description tuning, persona scope changes) whose vocabulary overlaps.

queries.q: improve this persona — its review lens keeps missing the same class of bug
refine the reviewer persona's Unique Questions from the last few review misses
schärfe die Unique Questions dieser Persona anhand der letzten Korrekturen nach
the security persona missed tenant scoping three times now — tighten its questions so it fires next time
here are four corrections the architecture lens should have surfaced; sharpen that lens against them
create a new persona for a database reviewer voice
queries.note: authoring a NEW persona file (voice / focus / output expectations), not refining an existing lens → persona-writing

queries.q: can I add a third specialist persona to this domain, or do I have to deprecate one?
queries.note: per-domain cap / citation floor / deprecation path question → persona-governance (rule)

queries.q: the persona should now also cover frontend performance, widen its scope
queries.note: identity / scope change is a new-id change, explicitly out of this loop's scope → persona-governance (rule)

queries.q: run the skill improvement pipeline now that we captured that learning
queries.note: skill-side capture → classify → create → validate → apply loop, not the persona analog → skill-improvement-pipeline

queries.q: this skill's description is too vague, rewrite it so it triggers reliably
queries.note: SKILL.md description / trigger tuning, not a persona's Unique Questions → description-assist (authoring rules in skill-writing)
